name: Sunken Step
hint: A bridge that sinks with a crate on it keeps the crate.
catch: the lever raises the goal's bridge but sinks the west bridge, your only way back north. A crate waiting on that bridge at the flip drops in and stays as a step — but the one crate that can get there is walled in. First drown the other two in the south springs to pave a path around it, push it onto the bridge, then pull the lever.
